content:
alex: FYI hitting a resolution failure when running sample-app in edge (Cloudflare). Node dev works; edge bundle says `Package entry not found` for our workspace import.
sara: paste import + package.json exports pls
alex: import: `import { Client } from '@rw/sdk';`
package.json (in @rw/sdk): ```json {"name":"@rw/sdk","exports":{"./package.json":"./package.json","./*":"./*",".":{"import":"./dist/index.mjs","require":"./dist/index.cjs"}}}```
edge err: `Error: No matching export in "@rw/sdk" for import "./dist/index.mjs"`
chad: pnpm symlink layout + exports field confuses bundlers (esbuild/vite). They resolve into the symlink target path that isn't covered by exports.
alex: repro: pnpm workspace, app -> @rw/sdk (workspace: protocol), pnpm v7 default linker. esbuild target=browser platform=neutral fails at bundle time.
sara: two quick fixes: (1) alias the package to dist/index.mjs in bundler, or (2) add explicit export for the path the bundler uses.
tina: vite alias example: `resolve: { alias: { '@rw/sdk': path.resolve(__dirname, '../packages/sdk/dist/index.mjs') } }`
chad: or add permissive export like "./dist/index.mjs":"./dist/index.mjs" under exports.
alex: adding explicit ./dist/index.mjs fixed it locally. Is that a long-term change? feels hacky.
sara: long-term options: document the edge gotcha in SDK README, add CI test that builds sample-apps for edge, or set pnpm node-linker=hoisted during build.
tina: note: `node --preserve-symlinks` helps Node but not esbuild/worker bundlers.
chad: TS types usually ok because TS uses `types`/paths; runtime bundlers use exports + Node resolution.
alex: I'll push vite alias change to sample-app and open RW-1834 to investigate pnpm symlink + exports for edge bundlers.
dev-bot: Created task RW-1834: "Investigate pnpm symlink + exports issues for edge bundlers" assigned to alex.
sara: also add a short note in SDK README about monorepo/workspace export-subpath pitfalls and example alias.
alex: will do, thanks :thumbsup:
